title: nodecrypt
tagline: Sign in with your Ethereum wallet — no passwords, ever.

connect.title: Connect your wallet
connect.description: We ask your wallet for permission to see your address — nothing else is shared.

sign.title: Sign a message
sign.description: You sign a one-time message to prove you control that address. No gas, no transaction.

verified.title: You're in
verified.description: We verify the signature on our server and start your session — no password, no email.
